description: This source file (rdm_openssl.c) implements cryptographic functions for the RDM agent, including buffer dumping, ASCII-hex and binary conversions, SHA-256 hashing of files, signature verification using OpenSSL, and preparation of files for signature verification. It also initializes the OpenSSL library and handles related utilities such as reading signatures and validating signed data. The file references multiple external libraries like OpenSSL and internal project headers for types, utilities, and configurations.
